# No hard-coded colours or sizes

`M8` · Coding rule

No hardcoded design values in new lines: colours, font sizes/families, spacing, radii, shadows come from tokens (App/styles/tokens.js, approved set in design-system.md; legacy theme allowed only where the approved token doesn't exist yet)

Defined in [[brain/context/conventions-mobile|Mobile app coding rules]].
